title: Selling Eggs at the Market

readiness.math: counting on from a price to give change (younger: from 5; older: from 10, with 1, 2 and 5-coins)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: It's market day! Your hens laid so many eggs, we have plenty to sell. Will you mind my egg stall with me?

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: When a customer pays, count the change from the price. If it costs 3 and they give you 5, count on: 4, 5. That's two coins back.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: The {item} costs {price}. The customer gave you {paid}. Count the change onto the counter, then press Give change.

feedback.all_good: Every customer went home happy, with the right change. Thank you, dear!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Honest weights and right change: that's how neighbors trust each other.

journal_line: I helped Mrs. Ruth sell eggs at the market, and counted the change.
unavailable_text: The eggs are all sold for today.
